formula: all c: Cleanup | c in Ran implies c in Registered
before:
For every cleanup_1:
  when cleanup_1 has run, code has registered cleanup_1.
after:
For every cleanup:
  when the cleanup has run, code has registered the cleanup.

formula: all c: Cleanup | some c.on implies c in Ran
before:
For every cleanup_1:
  when cleanup_1 is on an owner, cleanup_1 has run.
after:
For every cleanup:
  when the cleanup is on an owner, the cleanup has run.

formula: all o: Owner | o in Disposed implies o not in Stopped
before:
For every owner_1:
  when pulse has disposed owner_1, the dispose of owner_1 has not been stopped.
after:
For every owner:
  when pulse has disposed the owner, the dispose of the owner has not been stopped.

formula: all c: Cleanup, o: Owner | c.at = o implies o in Disposed
before:
For every cleanup_1 and every owner_1:
  when cleanup_1 waits at owner_1, pulse has disposed owner_1.
after:
For every cleanup and every owner:
  when the cleanup waits at the owner, pulse has disposed the owner.

formula: some c: Cleanup | c in Ran and c not in Registered
before: There is a cleanup_1 such that cleanup_1 has run and code has not registered cleanup_1.
after: There is a cleanup such that the cleanup has run and code has not registered the cleanup.

formula: all c: Cleanup | always (c in Ran implies after c in Registered)
before:
For every cleanup_1:
  now and at every later moment:
    when cleanup_1 has run, then at the next moment, code has registered cleanup_1.
after:
For every cleanup:
  now and at every later moment:
    when the cleanup has run, then at the next moment, code has registered the cleanup.

formula: all c: Cleanup, o: Owner | o in c.on implies eventually o in Disposed
before:
For every cleanup_1 and every owner_1:
  when cleanup_1 is on owner_1, then now or at a later moment, pulse has disposed owner_1.
after:
For every cleanup and every owner:
  when the cleanup is on the owner, then now or at a later moment, pulse has disposed the owner.

formula: all o: Owner | (some c: Cleanup | o in c.on) implies o in Disposed
before:
For every owner_1:
  when a cleanup is on owner_1, pulse has disposed owner_1.
after:
For every owner:
  when a cleanup is on the owner, pulse has disposed the owner.

formula: all c: Cleanup | c.home in Disposed iff c in Ran
before:
For every cleanup_1:
  both or neither of these hold:
    - for every owner_1:
        when owner_1 is the home of cleanup_1, pulse has disposed owner_1
    - cleanup_1 has run
after:
For every cleanup:
  both or neither of these hold:
    - for every owner:
        when the owner is the home of the cleanup, pulse has disposed the owner
    - the cleanup has run

formula: all c: Cleanup, o: Owner | (o in c.on and c in Ran) implies o not in Stopped
before:
For every cleanup_1 and every owner_1:
  when cleanup_1 is on owner_1 and has run, the dispose of owner_1 has not been stopped.
after:
For every cleanup and every owner:
  when the cleanup is on the owner and has run, the dispose of the owner has not been stopped.

formula: all c: Cleanup, o: Owner | c in Registered until o in Disposed
before:
For every cleanup_1 and every owner_1:
  all of these hold:
    - now or at a later moment, the following holds:
        pulse has disposed owner_1
    - at every moment from now until the first such moment, not including it, the following holds:
        code has registered cleanup_1.
after:
For every cleanup_1 and every owner_1:
  pulse has disposed owner_1 now or at a later moment, and code has registered cleanup_1 at every moment from now until the first such moment, not including it.

formula: all c: Cleanup | (c not in Ran) until c in Registered
before:
For every cleanup_1:
  all of these hold:
    - now or at a later moment, the following holds:
        code has registered cleanup_1
    - at every moment from now until the first such moment, not including it, the following holds:
        cleanup_1 has not run.
after:
For every cleanup_1:
  code has registered cleanup_1 now or at a later moment, and cleanup_1 has not run at every moment from now until the first such moment, not including it.

formula: all c: Cleanup, o: Owner | c in Ran since o in Disposed
before:
For every cleanup_1 and every owner_1:
  all of these hold:
    - now or at an earlier moment, the following holds:
        pulse has disposed owner_1
    - at every moment after the last such moment, up to and including now, the following holds:
        cleanup_1 has run.
after:
For every cleanup_1 and every owner_1:
  pulse has disposed owner_1 now or at an earlier moment, and cleanup_1 has run at every moment after the last such moment, up to and including now.

formula: all c: Cleanup, o: Owner | c in Registered implies (c not in Ran until o in Disposed)
before:
For every cleanup_1 and every owner_1:
  when code has registered cleanup_1
  then all of these hold:
         - now or at a later moment, the following holds:
             pulse has disposed owner_1
         - at every moment from now until the first such moment, not including it, the following holds:
             cleanup_1 has not run.
after:
For every cleanup_1 and every owner_1:
  when code has registered cleanup_1
  then the following holds:
    pulse has disposed owner_1 now or at a later moment, and cleanup_1 has not run at every moment from now until the first such moment, not including it.
